title: Alternative Firing Workshop with Randy Brodnax – Salt Firing
evidence_sentence: The workshop includes two days of low-fire salt firing using aluminum and clay saggars.
evidence_quote: 2 Days of Firing: will include low-fire salt firing using aluminum and clay saggars, naked raku, mica & stannous chloride firing.
summary: This four-day workshop with Randy Brodnax was scheduled for May 1-4, 2026 but has been cancelled.
bring: 10 small (8″x8″) grogged bisque pieces (Soldate-60 clay) or available for purchase
